about.story: The first version was a static page, mostly written by AI and so bloated it was barely usable (<old>it's still online</old>). This one is a rewrite in Vite and React that I write myself, with real servers behind it, so it can do things a static page never could.
about.lead: My personal website, and the place where I learn web development by building real things with it.
